basis: Inference: conservative engineering mass allowances, not maker or measured masses. Body and mated-plug allowances are separate additive lumped masses. Validate by weighing the actual populated board and supported harness. Connector/capacitor dimensions: parts_qualification.md; GH drawings eGH.pdf pp2-3; DB125 drawing T0-1; MA drawing p2. No inherited R9 RF or SMA masses.
placement: tools/plate_model.py --profile r10 places every key: on its own fit-report row's model box, or, for 'X mated' with no row of its own (J1 / J121 / J124: the DB125 terminals' wire and ferrule allowance, no mated envelope in fit_check), on its parent X's model box; any other key is refused (R3-MEC-01)

removed_bench_only.J2: TC2030 Tag-Connect: a bare land (fit_check board feature), no body on the board
removed_bench_only.J2 mated: the TC2030 cable is a bench programming tool, never fitted in flight
removed_bench_only.J3 mated: the USB-C plug is a bench / ground tool, never fitted in flight (J3's body mass stays)

harness_rule: Strain relief carries cable mass beyond the modelled plug/local-wire envelope; unrestrained long leads invalidate these allowances.
